instrument: NAACP v. xAI and MZX Tech, No. 3:26-cv-00074-MPM-JMV (N.D. Miss.)
summary: Clean Air Act citizen suit filed Apr 14, 2026 alleging operation of unpermitted gas turbines in Southaven powering Colossus 2; seeks injunction, best available control technology and per-day penalties. Preliminary injunction motion filed May 2026. DOJ moved to intervene seeking dismissal, with a DoD declaration citing national security.

source.citation: Earthjustice/SELC releases, Apr-May 2026; Utility Dive, June 2026

notes: Status 'proposed' used for pending litigation, consistent with mi-wixom-federal-complaint.
confidence_note: Docket not read; rulings on intervention, injunction and dismissal unknown after June 2026.
